entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I just need the shipping label.
I can certainly help with that. Can I start with your order number, please?
VF-987654321. Let's get this done quickly, I have another call in five minutes.

Of course. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 1st. To make sure I process this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not faulty, I just don't need it. I already tried to return it last weekend, but your website was down. I just need the label.
I understand. You mentioned a website error when you tried to process the return? Can you tell me a bit more about that?
Yes, on Saturday. The whole returns page just said 'system down for maintenance'. I couldn't get through to the form, so I couldn't print the label. I took a screenshot of it if you need proof.
Thank you for that information. Let me check my internal notes... ah, yes. I do see we had a known system issue with the returns portal that day. My apologies for that inconvenience.
So, are you sending the label or not?
One moment while I check the policy. Okay, looking here... yes, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this for you.
I've just processed the return authorization. The email with the printable label is on its way to your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
